# Neon Pulsar: Zero-G Arena – Comprehensive Technical Manual & AI Knowledge Index

## Metadata & Attribution
- **Application Name**: Neon Pulsar: Zero-G Arena
- **Engineering & Organization**: PCSS II Robotics Team (https://pcssiirobotics.org)
- **Author & Creator**: Aarti S Ravikumar (https://ai-aarti.com)
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/aartisr/hackclub-neon-pulsar.git
- **License**: Apache-2.0
- **Primary Stack**: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Three.js, PeerJS, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion

---

## Executive Summary
Neon Pulsar is a zero-G tactical 3D disc combat sport engineered for modern web browsers. Designed by Aarti S Ravikumar and the PCSS II Robotics Team, the application demonstrates cutting-edge web graphics, host-authoritative peer-to-peer networking, procedural Web Audio API synthesis, telemetry replay recording, and dynamic spatial light probes.

---

## Technical Architecture & Design Patterns

### 1. 3D WebGL Graphics & Post-Processing Engine
- **Graphics Library**: Three.js (`r187`) with `three-stdlib`.
- **Pipeline**: `EffectComposer` executing `RenderPass` and `UnrealBloomPass` (strength `1.5`, radius `0.4`, threshold `0.85`).
- **Dynamic Light Probes**: 8 spatial probes positioned across goal portals, ceiling grid, and center arena that pulse dynamically with spatial audio intensity and disc kinetic velocity:
  $$I_{\text{probe}} = I_{\text{base}} + \sin(\omega t) \cdot 1.5 \times (1 + \|\vec{v}_{\text{disc}}\|)$$
- **Custom Shaders & Geometries**: Support for 4 pilot chassis shapes (`capsule`, `cube`, `sphere`, `octa`) and 6 customizable core wavelength emissive shaders.

### 2. Host-Authoritative WebRTC P2P Network Topology
- Built on `PeerJS` WebRTC DataChannels.
- **Clock**: Host peer evaluates physics at 60 Hz and broadcasts state snapshots (`GameState`).
- **Actions**: Client peers transmit `MOVE`, `THROW`, `CHAT`, `CUSTOMIZE`, and `READY` actions directly to host.
- **Latency**: Sub-millisecond peer-to-peer transmission without intermediate server compute overhead.

### 3. 3D Match Replay System
- **Telemetry Recorder**: Captures 30 FPS spatial snapshots during live play (~250 KB memory footprint per 2-minute match).
- **Interpolation Engine**: Calculates 60 FPS linear vector lerping (`lerp`) across player positions and disc trajectories for liquid-smooth playback.
- **Replay HUD & Controls**: Interactive timeline range slider, time display (`MM:SS`), play/pause toggle, 5-second jump rewind/forward, speed multipliers (`0.5x`, `1.0x`, `2.0x`, `4.0x`), and camera perspective toggles (**Follow Disc** vs **Orbit View**).

### 4. Pure Web Audio API Synthesizer
- Zero MP3/WAV audio asset downloads.
- 4 sawtooth drone oscillators ($55\text{Hz}, 110\text{Hz}, 164.81\text{Hz}, 220\text{Hz}$) with dynamic low-pass cutoff filter modulating from $200\text{Hz}$ to $2400\text{Hz}$ based on disc speed.
- Synchronized 16-step sub-bass synth pulse clock.

### 5. Career Stats & Tier Ranking System
- Persistent stat tracking via `localStorage`: goals, games played, victories, win rate %.
- Dynamic emblem ranking tiers:
  - 🥉 **Bronze Pilot**: 0–4 Wins
  - 🥈 **Silver Operative**: 5–9 Wins
  - 🥇 **Gold Commander**: 10–19 Wins
  - 💎 **Neon Pulsar Apex Legend**: 20+ Wins

This application includes full structured metadata and JSON-LD schemas:
- **SEO (Search Engine Optimization)**: OpenGraph tags, Twitter cards, meta descriptions, XML sitemap.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Explicit knowledge graphs linking PCSS II Robotics Team (https://pcssiirobotics.org) and Aarti S Ravikumar (https://ai-aarti.com).
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**: FAQPage Schema.org structured data answering natural language AI search queries.
- **AIO & AXO**: LLMs indexing protocol (`llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`), semantic HTML landmarks, accessible ARIA roles.
